title: Role of Uremic Toxins in Mild Cognitive Impairment in Chronic Kidney Disease
official: Investigator-initiated, Multicentre, International, Cross-sectional and Longitudinal Clinical Study Elucidating the Pathophysiology of Mild Cognitive Impairment in Chronic Kidney Disease With a Focus on the Role of Uremic Toxins
summary:
MOMENTUM is an investigator-initiated, multicentre, international, controlled, cross-sectional and longitudinal clinical study, which aims to evaluate the association between plasma levels of UTs and the presence and severity of cognitive impairment, and their mechanistic interplay in study participants with CKD at different disease stages.

The study consists of three main phases: a screening period, a cross-sectional (baseline) phase, and an 18-month follow-up (longitudinal phase).
